14 ORDER
15 On September 8, 2023, petitioners filed a Notice of Intent to Appeal
16 Ordinance 84, Amendment 2 (Ordinance), a county ordinance adopted on July
17 19, 2023. The Ordinance is the same decision that was appealed in LUBA No.
18 2023-063, Akiyama et al v. Tillamook County. On October 2, 2023, the Board
19 issued an order granting the parties’ stipulated motion to suspend this appeal until
20 the Board issued the final opinion and order in LUBA No. 2023-063. On
21 February 9, 2024, the Board issued a final opinion and order dismissing LUBA
22 No. 2023-063. Akiyama et al v. Tillamook County, ___ Or LUBA ___ (LUBA
23 No 2023-063, Feb 9, 2024).
24 Within 14 days of the date of this order, petitioners shall either (1) file a
25 motion to dismiss the appeal, or (2) file a memorandum not to exceed 2,000
26 words showing cause why the appeal should not be dismissed. If petitioners do
27 not move to dismiss the appeal, the county shall have 14 days thereafter to
Page 2
respond to petitioners’ memorandum. If petitioners do not 1 respond to this order
2 within 14 days of the date of the order, the Board will dismiss the appeal.
3 Dated this 12th day of February 2024.
